credit.credit-words: I’ll Go Where You Want Me to Go
WORDS: Mary Brown, 1891. MUSIC: “Manchester”; Carrie E. Rounsefell, 1894. Public Domain.

Thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak. Jer. 1:7; Jn. 20:21 Then said I, Here am I; send me. Isa. 6:8 Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life. Ac. 5:20
